question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

Their sporting achievements at the highest level are being __utterly__ ignored.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"utterly"** means completely and without qualification; absolutely. (पूरी तरह से)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **utterly** convinced of her decision to move abroad.
 
 
 
• **"Minimally"** refers to something that is done to the smallest degree or amount possible. (न्यूनतम)
 
 
• **Example: **The instructions were **minimally** helpful in solving the problem.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'utterly' **is **'minimally'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Extremely **(अत्यंत): To a very great degree.

 
 
• **Example:** The weather was extremely cold last night.
 
 
 
• **Correctly **(सही ढंग से): In a way that is free from errors or mistakes.
 
 
• **Example: **She answered all the questions correctly.
 
 
 
• **Totally** (पूरी तरह से): Completely; absolutely.
 
 
• **Example:** He was totally unaware of the upcoming surprise.
